description_en: Queries the available session instance types for the current account by paging based on the product, region, operating system, and instance type conditions
description_zh: 按产品、地域、操作系统及规格条件分页查询当前账号可使用的会话规格
name: ListAppInstanceType

parameters.help_en:
The product type. Set the value to the following fixed value when you call this operation:

`CloudApp`: Wuying Cloud Application
parameters.help_zh:
产品类型。调用时固定填写以下取值：

`CloudApp`：无影云应用
parameters.name: product_type

parameters.help_en: The application image ID. The current session instance type query does not filter based on this parameter. Omit this parameter. Do not infer image compatibility based on whether this parameter is specified
parameters.help_zh: 应用镜像ID。当前会话规格查询不根据此参数筛选，建议省略；请勿用本参数的填写情况推断镜像兼容性
parameters.name: app_center_image_id

parameters.help_en: The business region ID. If this parameter is omitted, the region of the current request is used. The available instance types may vary by region and account. You can call the ListRegions (https://api.aliyun.com/document/appstream-center/2021-09-01/ListRegions) operation to obtain the business region ID
parameters.help_zh: 业务地域ID。省略时使用本次请求的地域；不同地域和账号可查询到的规格可能不同。可通过 ListRegions (https://api.aliyun.com/document/appstream-center/2021-09-01/ListRegions) 获取
parameters.name: biz_region_id

parameters.help_en:
The language of the instance type name.

`zh-CN`: Use the Chinese name of the instance type.
Other values or omitted: Use the instance type code as the name.

This parameter only affects the display of `InstanceTypeName` and does not change the instance type code
parameters.help_zh:
规格名称的语言选择。

`zh-CN`：使用规格的中文名称。
其他取值或省略：使用规格代码作为名称。

该参数只影响 `InstanceTypeName` 的展示，不改变规格代码
parameters.name: language

parameters.help_en:
The operating system type. In the Wuying Cloud Application (CloudApp) scenario, set the value to:

`Windows`: Windows operating system.

If this parameter is omitted, no operating system filtering condition is added
parameters.help_zh:
操作系统类型。无影云应用（CloudApp）场景使用以下取值：

`Windows`：Windows操作系统。

省略时不增加操作系统筛选条件
parameters.name: os_type

parameters.help_en:
The instance type category filtering condition. If this parameter is omitted, no category filtering condition is added. Valid values:

`Cpu`: CPU instance type.
`Gpu`: GPU instance type
parameters.help_zh:
规格分类筛选条件。省略时不增加分类筛选条件。取值：

`Cpu`：CPU规格。
`Gpu`：GPU规格
parameters.name: category

parameters.help_en: The session instance type code. Exact match is performed based on the complete code. If this parameter and `AppInstanceTypeList` are specified at the same time, the results are filtered by intersection. You can perform a conditional query without this condition first, and then select the returned codes
parameters.help_zh: 会话规格代码，按完整代码精确匹配。与 `AppInstanceTypeList` 同时填写时按交集筛选。可使用本接口先不带此条件查询，再选用返回的代码
parameters.name: app_instance_type

parameters.help_en: The instance type family code. Exact match is performed based on the complete code. Use the instance type family value from the query results. Do not extract it from the instance type name
parameters.help_zh: 规格族代码，按完整代码精确匹配。应选用查询结果中的规格族值，不要从规格名称自行截取
parameters.name: app_instance_type_family

parameters.help_en: The number of CPU cores for exact filtering. Use a decimal numeric string. Unit: cores. If this parameter is omitted, the number of CPU cores is not limited
parameters.help_zh: 按CPU核数精确筛选，使用十进制数值字符串，单位：核。省略时不限定CPU核数
parameters.name: cpu

parameters.help_en: The memory capacity for exact filtering. Unit: MB. If this parameter is omitted, the memory capacity is not limited
parameters.help_zh: 按内存容量精确筛选，单位：MB。省略时不限定内存容量
parameters.name: memory

parameters.help_en: The GPU memory capacity for exact filtering. Unit: MB. If this parameter is omitted, the GPU memory capacity is not limited
parameters.help_zh: 按显存容量精确筛选，单位：MB。省略时不限定显存容量
parameters.name: gpu_memory

parameters.help_en:
The billing method used to filter available instance types. If this parameter is omitted, no billing method condition is added. Valid values:

`PrePaid`: subscription.
`PostPaid`: pay-as-you-go
parameters.help_zh:
按目标付费方式筛选可用规格。省略时不增加付费方式条件。取值：

`PrePaid`：包年包月付费。
`PostPaid`：按量付费
parameters.name: charge_type

parameters.help_en: The page number. Explicitly specify a page number starting from 1. If this parameter is omitted, the default value 0 is used to query the first batch of results. For subsequent pages, request in the order of 1, 2, and 3
parameters.help_zh: 页码。建议显式填写从 1 开始的页码；省略时采用默认值 0，查询首批结果。后续页请按 1、2、3 的顺序请求
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of instance types returned per page. Unit: entries. Default value: 200. Explicitly set a positive integer that meets your business requirements. The default value here does not represent the maximum value allowed by the service
parameters.help_zh: 每页返回的规格数量，单位：条。默认值：200。建议显式设置符合业务需要的正整数；此处默认值不表示服务允许的最大值
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The list of session instance type codes. A maximum of 100 items are supported. This parameter takes effect by intersection with other filtering conditions. If this parameter and `AppInstanceType` are specified at the same time, the results must also match the single code
parameters.help_zh: 会话规格代码列表，最多 100 项。与其他筛选条件按交集生效；与 `AppInstanceType` 同时填写时，结果还须与该单个代码一致
parameters.name: app_instance_type_list

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to query the instance type inventory at the same time. Default value: `false`.

`true`: Queries the inventory and returns InventoryInfo when the inventory information is available.
`false`: Queries only the instance types and does not query the inventory
parameters.help_zh:
是否同时查询规格库存。默认值：`false`。

`true`：查询库存，并在能够取得库存信息时返回 InventoryInfo。
`false`：仅查询规格，不查询库存
parameters.name: query_inventory

schema.description_en: The response information for this call

AppInstanceTypeModels.description_en: The list of session instance types on the current page
AppInstanceTypeModels.description_zh: 当前页的会话规格列表

AppInstanceType.description_en: The session instance type code, which can be used as the session instance type parameter for subsequent operations
AppInstanceType.description_zh: 会话规格代码，可作为后续接口的会话规格参数

AppInstanceTypeFamily.description_en: The instance type family code to which the session instance type belongs
AppInstanceTypeFamily.description_zh: 会话规格所属的规格族代码

Cpu.description_en: The number of CPU cores included in the instance type, represented by a numeric string. Unit: cores
Cpu.description_zh: 规格包含的CPU核数，使用数值字符串表示，单位：核

DataDiskSize.description_en: The data cloud disk capacity of the instance type. Unit: GB
DataDiskSize.description_zh: 规格的数据盘容量，单位：GB

Gpu.description_en: Not enabled yet. The example value is only used to demonstrate the format and does not represent the actual number of GPUs returned by this operation
Gpu.description_zh: 暂未启用。示例值仅用于展示格式，不代表本接口当前实际返回的GPU数量

GpuMemory.description_en: The GPU memory capacity of the instance type. Unit: MB

GpuSpec.description_en: The display value or display range of the GPU memory. Display it as the returned text. Do not directly use it as a numeric value for capacity conversion
GpuSpec.description_zh: 显存的展示值或展示范围，应按返回文本展示，不应直接作为数值进行容量换算

Id.description_en: The identifier of the instance type record. When integrating with pricing or creation operations, use `AppInstanceType`. Do not use this field to replace the instance type code
Id.description_zh: 规格记录的标识。对接询价或创建接口时应使用 `AppInstanceType`，不要用本字段替代规格代码

InstanceTypeName.description_en: The display name of the instance type. The Chinese name is used only when `Language` is set to `zh-CN`. For other values or when omitted, the instance type code is used
InstanceTypeName.description_zh: 规格显示名称。仅 `Language=zh-CN` 时使用中文名称；其他取值或省略时为规格代码

InventoryInfo.description_en: The inventory information of the instance type. This parameter is returned only when the inventory is queried and the relevant information is obtained. If this parameter is not returned, it does not mean that the inventory is 0
InventoryInfo.description_zh: 规格的库存信息。仅在请求查询库存且取得相关信息时返回；未返回不等于库存为 0

RegionId.description_en: The business region ID corresponding to the inventory query
RegionId.description_zh: 库存查询对应的业务地域ID

Status.description_en:
The instance type inventory status obtained in the current query.

`Available`: The total inventory of the queried zones is greater than 0.
`SoldOut`: The total inventory of the queried zones is not greater than 0
Status.description_zh:
当前查询取得的规格库存状态。

`Available`：查询到的可用区库存合计大于0。
`SoldOut`：查询到的可用区库存合计不大于0

ZoneInventoryInfo.description_en: The list of inventory information returned by zone
ZoneInventoryInfo.description_zh: 按可用区返回的库存信息列表

items.description_en: The inventory information of a zone
items.description_zh: 一个可用区的库存信息

Amount.description_en: The available quantity in the zone obtained in this query. Unit: instances. This value is an inventory snapshot and does not indicate that resources have been reserved for the current account
Amount.description_zh: 本次查询得到的该可用区可用数量，单位：个。该值是库存快照，不表示已为当前账号预留资源

ZoneId.description_en: The zone ID, which can be queried by calling the ListZones (https://api.aliyun.com/document/appstream-center/2021-09-01/ListZones) operation
ZoneId.description_zh: 可用区ID，可通过 ListZones (https://api.aliyun.com/document/appstream-center/2021-09-01/ListZones) 查询

Memory.description_en: The memory capacity of the instance type. Unit: MB

ProductType.description_en:
The type of the product to which the instance type belongs. The current document displays the following values:

`CloudApp`: Wuying Cloud Application
ProductType.description_zh:
所属产品的类型。当前文档展示以下取值：

`CloudApp`：无影云应用

SystemDiskSize.description_en: The system cloud disk capacity of the instance type. Unit: GB
SystemDiskSize.description_zh: 规格的系统盘容量，单位：GB

PageNumber.description_en: The page number used in this query, which corresponds to the request parameters and the total number of entries
PageNumber.description_zh: 本次查询采用的页码；用于与请求参数及总条数对应

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page used in this query
PageSize.description_zh: 本次查询采用的每页条数

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier of the request, which can be used to troubleshoot request issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次请求的唯一标识，可用于定位请求问题

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of instance types that meet all filtering conditions, not the number of entries on the current page
TotalCount.description_zh: 满足全部筛选条件的规格总条数，不是当前页的条数
